item.text: The campaign is live with both approved posts, targeting the UK and Ireland with no age restriction. It optimizes for the verified “Release opened” event, with a $350 total cap and an end time of midnight BST after July 30. I can monitor through the full flight; I’ll check delivery and conversion results regularly.
The first day spent $28.28 and reported 6 release openings from 14 link clicks. Both posts are delivering; I’ll give the conversion optimizer more time before changing the setup.
After two days, spend is $56.39 with 18 attributed release openings. Cost per opening has improved from $4.71 to $3.13, so I’m keeping the current setup running.

After three days, the second post has generated 25 attributed openings at $1.77 each, versus 10 at $4.08 for the first. I’m moving the remaining $264.88 to the second post while keeping the combined budget capped at $350.

Five days in, spend is $145.59 with 60 attributed openings and 94 link clicks. Delivery is close to the planned pace, and the remaining budget is sufficient for the seven days left.
At halfway, the campaign has spent $173.86 and reported 68 release openings. Results have softened over the last two days; I’ll check whether that continues before narrowing the audience.

The last three days produced 24 additional openings for $87.01. I’m narrowing delivery to people interested in music to try to improve the cost per opening, while retaining the UK and Ireland locations and all ages.
